findings.description: Critical: Direct registry loader `_config_from_agents_yaml` bypassed `project_principals` topology projection and validation. In commit 96827d55, `_config_from_agents_yaml` manually formatted SPIFFE IDs and passed raw `vendor_credentials` without validating against the `credential_vendors` catalog, checking for duplicate agents or slug validity, forbidding manual `openbao_role_id`, or rejecting keyless agents declaring vendor credentials. This violated the canonical principal topology contract (D1, AI-02, AI-13, AI-16). (Note: resolved in follow-up commit ad466899 via `project_principals` projection).

findings.resolution: Validate `agents.yaml` via `project_principals(raw, mount=os.environ.get("BAO_MOUNT_PATH", "secret"))` in `_config_from_agents_yaml`, catching `ProjectionError` and mapping projected principal records by name (as implemented in commit ad466899).

findings.description: none: `ApiKeyResolver.resolve()` verifies that `principal_id` matches the canonical SPIFFE regex and checks `vendor_id in self._scopes.get(principal_id, ())` before initializing `OpenBaoClient` or calling `ensure_session` or `read_vendor_key`. Undeclared vendor credential requests fail loud with `AUTHORIZATION_DENIED` before any network or filesystem Vault access.
findings.resolution: No action needed; complies with D2, AI-01, and AI-08.

findings.description: none: In configured OpenBao mode (`BAO_ADDR` set), `ApiKeyResolver` exclusively queries `OpenBaoClient` and raises typed `BaoCredentialError` on any error without falling back to ambient environment variables (e.g. `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) or static shared-secret paths. Non-OpenBao development mode preserves configured environment key resolution.
findings.resolution: No action needed; complies with D2, CFG-01, CFG-02, CFG-04, and AI-05.

findings.description: none: `ApiKeyResolver` dropped the legacy in-memory credential cache dict (`self._cache`). Secret reads are performed afresh on each `resolve()` call via `client.read_vendor_key()`, ensuring that OpenBao key rotations take effect immediately without requiring process restart, while session token lifecycle remains serialized and protected on disk by `ensure_session()`.
